title: Document diagram playback controls
summary: The README now explains System, Play, and Pause, including the report-only override for reduced motion. This example explains a documentation change; it does not verify browser behavior.

context.problem: Readers need to understand why a diagram may be static and how playback can be enabled.
context.baseline: The previous README had no dedicated diagram-animation guidance.
context.scope: Only the new README playback paragraph is explained. Renderer changes and historical test results are outside this scope.

changes.title: Explain the three playback options
changes.description: System follows the motion preference; Play enables motion for the report; Pause freezes playback.
changes.why: A static diagram can be expected behavior under reduced motion.

evidence.label: Read the inspected README paragraph
evidence.detail: Inspected with git show at the pinned revision. The statements describe the documented controls, not independently verified runtime behavior.

impact.description: The documentation now describes the controls and the reduced-motion override.
The guidance may help readers distinguish intentional static playback from a malfunction; no usability measurement is claimed.
